summary: Map forecast hazard exposure and WorldPop population
description:
Loads a hazard forecast and one WorldPop population year over the requested area, then overlays hazard severity on the population grid using nearest-neighbour resampling. Hazard categories 1-4 are exposed, 0 is unexposed, and cells outside 0-4 or without data are missing.

Use `variable: heatstress_exposure` to publish one four-dimensional GeoZarr variable with `time`, `exposure_level`, `y`, and `x` dimensions. Its exposure_level coordinate contains categories 1-3, and each slice contains the population in cells at exactly that category; unexposed cells contain zero and missing cells remain missing. No hazard-severity band is included in this population output. Existing `exposed_population` and `hazard_severity` modes remain available for publishing one variable per run.

Zarr output cannot be produced synchronously, so run this as a batch job (POST /jobs, then POST /jobs/{id}/results). The hazard temporal extent can include multiple forecast dates; population_temporal_extent selects one WorldPop year.

parameters.name: hazard_dataset_id
parameters.description: Published hazard dataset, for example heatstress_hazard_forecast_daily.

parameters.name: hazard_temporal_extent
parameters.description: Forecast interval as [first date, last date], up to the available forecast period.

parameters.name: population_temporal_extent
parameters.description: The WorldPop year to use as [start-of-year, end-of-year], for example ["2020-01-01", "2020-12-31"].

parameters.name: spatial_extent
parameters.description: Area to process, as a west/east/south/north bounding box in EPSG:4326 unless crs is given.

parameters.name: population_dataset_id
parameters.description: Population collection to use. Defaults to WorldPop global2 at 100 m.

parameters.name: variable
parameters.description: Which variable to publish. Must match the `variable` of the template registered for output_dataset_id.

parameters.name: output_dataset_id
parameters.description: ID of the registered static dataset template to publish. Defaults to the heat-stress exposure cube.
